implemented_core_mechanics: chapter-based side-scrolling combo brawler flow with six selectable chapter routes and a dedicated training room
touch controls for move jump dodge combo attack and chi burst with buffered attack continuation
4-step grounded route with launcher timing aerial follow-up pressure dodge repositioning and chi cash-out
chi meter gain and spend loop with a forward lane-clearing burst and layered burst presentation
enemy roster spread across scout flyer brute ranger assassin and gate captain roles with per-type pressure behavior
chapter clear reward flow with score style rank and post-clear gold crest and scroll payout
hero loadout screen with combo chi and survivability upgrade lanes
codex screen for enemy families and technique notes
menu chapter select pause result game over and training overlays with tracked UI pack assignment
tracked gameplay art assignment with integrated runtime art map
animation_and_facing_evidence: GameView flips the hero and enemy sprites by facing direction during movement and combat
GameView alternates hero walk frames grunt walk frames flyer flap frames and boss walk frames at runtime
Enemy supports airborne launch state knockback carry landing stun and family-specific pursuit pressure for combo routing
Player preserves combo timing queueing dodge invulnerability jump state and chi cooldown state instead of using a single static action
ChiBurst renders expanding layered energy rings arcs and orbit particles instead of a plain placeholder projectile
known_limitations: The six chapters are systemic route variants rather than fully bespoke authored stage geometry for every node in the broader long-term content plan.
The art pack remains a shared fantasy-platformer assignment, so the hero attractiveness target is reached more through presentation and motion than through custom portrait-grade character art.
The codex and loadout screens cover the confirmed structure and growth lanes, but later polish can deepen their content density and bespoke visual treatment.
remaining_quality_notes: The implementation now preserves the confirmed identity: chapter progression, combo routing, dodge utility, chi spectacle, post-clear upgrades, training support, and richer enemy pressure instead of collapsing into a one-room boss trial.
Further polish is still valuable, but the current build is close enough to the confirmed requirements to pass implementation fidelity for repository delivery gating.
